searchText: Will there be an East call today? I am asking to myself the same !? Maybe we can run this meeting by ourselves like last time if someone has the meeting link ? Sure, here is the updated link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82997806406?pwd=T1oxK2t3WFNzTkE4cG1nRmZ4WTdwUT09 Lets do it. I hope we are having a west call as well today 👀 It will be my first session. So looking forward to it https://tenor.com/view/nervous-sign-of-the-cross-praying-hoping-nico-santos-gif-10946409 🙂 https://twitter.com/protolambda/status/1456009006779191303 congrats <@!218397452309495809> 🚀 Congratulations <@218397452309495809> ! Also didn't know <@203220829473996800> was on optimism! That's a horrible hire, he spends 28 hours/day hacking the specs 😆 yea he is literally the leader in the hacking leaderboard 🚀 https://ethereum.org/en/eth2/get-involved/bug-bounty/ I made a sieve rule to filter out emails with commits from him Lol I won't be able to make it to the call today since I am writing a midterm during it. My update is I submitted the Offer/Accept PR for review and I might look into putting uTP into its own crate as it has been suggested by a few people. West stand up in 30 minutes. (Apologies for my unannounced absence in the east call. ) West standup now: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89323407305?pwd=cnUvVmpKRTgzVWdpYWtTc3phTlNpQT09
